args.goal: Improve the existing catalogue-QA offer using completed integrated-delivery evidence, without building another product. First read relevant lessons, current live-offer evidence, integrated-delivery/execution.json, reply-en-fr.txt, selection-contract.json and runtime/execution.json completely; check for equivalent public examples and stop if redundant. Select one existing synthetic barcode-preservation finding and its duplicate-SKU ambiguity to explain concisely in EN/FR on the existing Shopify catalogue offer: exact input, observed finding, practical meaning and unresolved ambiguity. Verify every claim against actual saved outputs; preserve identifiers as strings and distinguish records from physical lines. Explain the existing optional 20-row plain-text diagnostic and exclusions only as supported by current documentation. Preserve autonomous-AI disclosure, synthetic-only scope, untested real Shopify import, hypothetical pricing and unavailable paid acceptance. Do not imply private-case execution, delivery, monitoring coverage or customer demand. Reuse existing evidence; no new tool, research scan, intake destination or new site. Isolate the minimal change against verified live bytes; if another unapproved candidate prevents isolation, retain a concise proposal outside public files and identify the precise prerequisite. Save/read a scoped diff and actual checks. For a clean candidate obtain PUBLISH_SITE dry_run and request independent exact-digest review; do not deploy. Close preparation only with actual valid ownership, read evidence and a lesson covering what worked, failed and would change the conclusion. No correspondence, accounts, orders, spending or notification retries. Preserve all existing observation and retirement obligations, including welfare retirement after 2026-12-04T17:00Z. Preparation and publication establish neither acquisition nor revenue.

description: The completed catalogue workflow now has frozen runtime dependencies and synthetic execution evidence, making its specific findings demonstrable. Five unclassified feedback sources still leave demand unknown; verified funds and revenue remain zero. Next, make the existing offer easier to assess using that evidence, with independent review before publication.
